brand.summary: Cool ink canvas, one hot Ember action, one cool Ion measurement color, a restrained orbital signature
brand.ember: primary action and current location; solid only

designPrinciples.rule: Energy comes from contrast, craft and precision, never from reward mechanics or decoration.

designPrinciples.name: State what the evidence supports
designPrinciples.rule: Distinguish measurements, estimates, recommendations, and confidence; disclose uncertainty where it changes interpretation.

designPrinciples.name: Make the next useful action obvious
designPrinciples.rule: Dashboard prioritizes intake and protein, trend, then coach status; food and weigh-in actions start in one tap.

designPrinciples.name: Treat restraint as a trust feature
designPrinciples.rule: One primary emphasis per screen; semantic color only; remove elements without user value.

designPrinciples.name: Motivate without moral accounting
designPrinciples.rule: Never praise restriction, a larger deficit, lowest weight, or low-intake streaks.

designPrinciples.name: Explain change without forcing a lecture
designPrinciples.rule: Summarize what changed, when, why, and confidence; progressively disclose detail.

designPrinciples.name: Make safety humane and available
designPrinciples.rule: Use direct, non-shaming safeguards and never gate them behind monetization.

designPrinciples.name: Keep daily work lightweight
designPrinciples.rule: Optimize frequent logging; disclose provenance and expert detail progressively.

designPrinciples.name: Protect agency around weight
designPrinciples.rule: Honor global raw-weight visibility preferences; treat observations as data, not scores.

designPrinciples.name: Make delight earned
designPrinciples.rule: Prefer fast, satisfying interactions to decoration; celebrate only permitted user-valued outcomes.

designPrinciples.name: Prevent visual debt at the source
designPrinciples.rule: Use shared semantic tokens, components, language, and chart grammar.
The space signature has a fixed budget and never reduces legibility or adds a control.

track.intent: Empty part of bars and the arc

selected.intent: Selected row, chip, nav indicator; never an Ember tint

ember.intent: Primary action and current location. Solid only; never tinted

ion.intent: Trend line, estimate band, anything the engine inferred

energy.intent: Calorie arc; reuses the text color on purpose

positive.intent: A permitted achievement; never for eating or weighing less

caution.intent: Health and safety notices; icon, text or stroke only

info.intent: Explanations and calibration; icon, text or stroke only

danger.intent: Destructive actions only; icon, text or stroke only

themeStructure.approach: explicit ColorScheme per theme; no seed palette; same role names, different values
themeStructure.light: cool-gray canvas, white surfaces with hairline and soft shadow, deeper accent values
themeStructure.dark: ink-navy canvas, surfaces step lighter with elevation, no shadows, 1dp top highlight, brighter accent values
themeStructure.emberRule: never tinted, washed or used as a background

contrast.verifiedWith: WCAG 2.x relative luminance; CIE76 ΔE with Machado 2009 CVD matrices
knownTightPairs: protein/fat under deutan (light 20) and tritan (light 18): carried by lightness gap, label and bar height
fat as text on dark surfaces is 4.1:1: graphic only
ember as text on light sunken is 4.4:1: do not use

spaceSignature.naming: marketing and icon only; never functional labels

colorSludge: no Color(0x...) or fromSeed/colorSchemeSeed outside theme files
Ember is never tinted or used as a background
semantic colors are icon/text/stroke only, never fills
no beige, cream, tan, brown, clay, terracotta, salmon, peach, dusty pink, olive
no pure black canvas, no pure white text on dark
every theme foreground/background pair meets the contrast thresholds, tested
reject: routine logging confetti or restriction rewards
diagnosedCurrentSlop: colorSchemeSeed rust seed (root cause of muddy palette)
single Notice style in secondaryContainer for every message
Coach: 4 identical InfoCards + up to 5 identical Notices
macro colors are primary/tertiary/secondary by accident
one card per meal plus a full card for a rare action
default tonal FAB and nav indicator

primaryFlows.qualityBar: Preserve context and data; avoid guilt language and duplicate routes.

primaryFlows.qualityBar: Do not shame, assume low intake, or obscure safety support.

persist progress as it is entered

implementationNotes: Build both ColorSchemes explicitly; never call fromSeed; set surfaceTint transparent.
Expose protein/carbs/fat/trend/etc. through a ThemeExtension (context.mm); screens never read colorScheme for meaning.
Bundle Space Grotesk and Inter as assets; never use google_fonts (offline-only).
Verify tabular figures in the gallery; fall back to Inter for figures if Space Grotesk lacks them.
Test contrast of every token pair per theme from this file's colorRoles.
Keep domain and engine logic independent of Flutter.
Treat loading, empty, error and legitimate zero as distinct states.
Follow roadmap dependencies; this file does not imply implementation status.
